gui.the_long_travail.diary.prose.boundle:
Ordinary days lie far behind.
The once-fallen sky
blooms slowly in the void.

Darkness twines like vines,
holds each step, guides the way.
Beyond that door, the traveler
is singular in an empty world.

Dream walks within dream;
sky hangs beyond sky.
The end, the end—
a little farther still.

The traveler records
the chaos of the void,
writes of the formless.
Wilds float amid the stars,
asleep in vast silence.

tooltip.the_long_travail.ancient_strange: Craft an item, nether quartz and Ancient Strange Tales in any order to transfer acceptable enchantments from the item into this book.
Craft an item, lapis lazuli and Ancient Strange Tales in any order to transfer acceptable enchantments from this book to the item.
Add a honey bottle for non-curse enchantments only, or a fermented spider eye for curses only. These filters cannot be combined.
Matching levels add up to 255. Overflow, conflicting, inapplicable and filtered-out enchantments stay on the source.
Only quartz or lapis and the filter are consumed; honey returns a glass bottle. Both items and their other data are retained. One item is processed per craft.
No materials are consumed if nothing can transfer. Two copies of Ancient Strange Tales cannot transfer to each other.
Supports chiseled bookshelves, enchanting tables, and anvil renaming or receiving enchanted books. This book cannot be consumed as an anvil enchantment ingredient.
Anvils retain normal level and cost rules. Combining the same enchantment may reduce an over-level enchantment to its normal maximum.
